resources.title: Subject Line Statistics
resources.content: Optimal length: 30-50 characters. Mobile cutoff: 35 characters. Personalized subjects: 26% higher open rates. Emojis can increase opens by 56% (test with audience).

resources.title: Common Spam Trigger Words
resources.content: Avoid: FREE, GUARANTEE, NO OBLIGATION, ACT NOW, LIMITED TIME, CLICK HERE, BUY NOW, SAVE $$$, 100% SATISFIED. Use sparingly: Discount, Deal, Offer, Sale.

resources.title: Best Email Send Times
resources.content: Tuesday-Thursday: Highest engagement. Best times: 10 AM, 2 PM, 8 PM (recipient's timezone). Avoid: Monday mornings, Friday afternoons.

resources.title: Email Power Words
resources.content: Urgency: Limited, Ending, Last chance, Today only. Exclusivity: Exclusive, VIP, Members only, Invitation. Value: Save, Free, Bonus, Gift. Action: Discover, Unlock, Get, Claim.
